owner_name.description: The owner row's stored display name.

location_captured_at.description: Device fix time, ISO-8601 with an offset (a time without one is read as UTC). A fix older than the stored one is ignored.

phone.description: Trimmed; 8-15 digits starting 1-9 get a leading `+`; then strict E.164.

invites.description: Processed in array order, in one transaction. Not an array → `invalid_invites`.

created.description: New rows (`resent: false`) and refreshed expired/declined rows (`resent: true`).

owner_name.description: The owner row's stored display name.

pending_count.description: Valid pending invites only: not canceled, not consumed, not expired.

avatar_url.description: Public URL of the row user's profile photo (`{SUPABASE_URL}/storage/v1/object/public/avatars/{path}`); null without a user or photo.

display_name.description: Active rows with a user: that user's current profile name (trimmed), else the stored name. Other rows: the stored invite name.

owner_name.description: The owner row's stored display name.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every non-2xx response (spec §11.2).

resident_name.description: The resident's full name; empty string when unknown.

actor_id.description: Who caused the event (null when no user did). The resident of the incident gets the full UUID. Any other caller gets it obscured: the first 4 and the last 4 hex characters are kept, every other hex character is replaced by "*", and the hyphens and 36-character shape stay (e.g. "4f3a****-****-****-****-********9c2d"), unless the actor is the caller, whose own id is always shown in full. Not a usable UUID when obscured.

invite_token.description: Only while `pending` (to accept or decline); null otherwise.

owner_name.description: The owner row's stored display name.

status.description: The lookup status (spec §5.3). Accepted (`consumed`) invitations are not listed.

invite_expires_at.description: Null when the token is not found.

circle_id.description: Only when the row is shown.

claimed.description: True when the invitation is (now) bound to the caller. Null where the SQL function returns null (e.g. the owner previewing an unclaimed invitation).

invited_at.description: Only when the row is shown.

member_id.description: Only when the row is shown.

owner_avatar_url.description: Only when the owner is shown: the owner's public avatar URL, or null.

owner_name.description: Only when the owner is shown: the owner row's stored display name.

recipient_ok.description: The caller may accept this invitation (spec rule 18).

status.description: Lookup status, or the display statuses `own_circle`, `already_member`, `circle_full`.

active_member_count.description: Active members of the circle, owner excluded (pending and declined excluded).

member_id.description: The caller's member row in that circle.

owner_name.description: The owner row's stored display name.

role.description: `owner` for the circle the caller owns (it is listed too, as today).

member_id.description: The caller's member row, now deleted.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between location uploads while an alert is active (default 12).

stale_threshold_seconds.description: A fix older than this many seconds is shown as stale (default 45).

invite_token.description: 64 lowercase hex characters; single use; 7-day expiry.

resent.description: True when an existing row was refreshed (same `member_id`).

capacity.description: Null when the caller owns no circle.

circle.description: Null when the caller owns no circle.

members.description: Owner view of the member list (owner row first); empty when there is no circle.

anyOf.description: Spec §4.4: one of the 7 relationship values.

relationship.description: Null or blank: none (an existing row keeps its own). Else one of the 7 values.

resident_name.description: The resident's full name; empty string when unknown.

incident_notes.description: Trimmed of spaces; empty or only spaces clears the note (null). At most 250 characters after trimming, else 422 set_incident_notes:too_long.
